warnings: This run rewrites MEDIA_VIA_DOOR in the RESPONSE, never in the file, and answers every press locally, so no object or row is written anywhere. A real upload against the deployed door is a separate act (0.11bc2).

Gallery.jsx and BusinessInfo.jsx both render err.message untranslated, so the refusal is read in English at every width on both screens. The door's sentences are DOOR_WORDS and their Spanish is tests/spanish.test.mjs section 12's subject, not this item's.

The sentence those two screens show is DOOR_WORDS.unreadable, which says 'Reload this job' on screens that are not a job. Found 2026-10-09, written up in FOUND.md, not this item's to fix — 0.11b is about which store the bytes go to, and the string is shared with JobPhotos.jsx where it is correct.

unjudgeable: That R2 accepts the signature, that Cloudflare serves the PUT, and that an unauthenticated visitor can read the url: no public address has been bound in Cloudflare yet (FOR-ANDREW.md step 9a2), so this run uses a test host through r2.ts's real reader. The DERIVATION is measured; the live address is Andrew's.

NOTHING about the intake flow is unjudgeable any more, and this line is kept rather than deleted because the reversal is the load-bearing part. This receipt said for four runs that intake 'is not pressed in the browser' and gave three reasons; two of them were true and described what there was to MEASURE rather than whether a browser could press it (ROADMAP 0.11bc1). It is now pressed at 1440, 392 and 320 like the other two, with the stored-url assertion replaced by its absence and the row-count assertion replaced by the brief's own 'n added' counter.

assertion_floor: 13 per flow-and-width (the picker count, the flag landed, zero storage uploads, one PUT, the key's folder, the success sentence, THE PERMANENT RECORD, the refusal present, the refusal's wording, its pixels, no PUT, WHAT THE REFUSAL LEFT BEHIND, no row body naming the other business) x 3 flows x 3 widths + 1 console = 118 when every screen renders. The two capitalised ones have a per-flow variant rather than being skipped on the flow that has no row: for intake the permanent record is asserted ABSENT (no row body anywhere carries a media url) and what the refusal left behind is the brief's own 'n added' counter, which is what a detailer reads. A screen that renders but refuses nothing still books its assertions as failures rather than dropping out, so the count cannot silently fall below 78. --break=public-url adds one per triple.
